major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use early in the opener to get its cooldown rolling and on cooldown thereafter, but only when you can safely complete the full channel; Shimmer to safety rather than canceling it, and save a charge for vulnerability phases or priority adds when Hand of Frost grants a second charge.

major_cooldowns.name: Comet Storm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown after Ray of Frost converts it, spending built Freezing stacks; in AoE it Shatters stacks on multiple targets at once, so prioritize Frostfire Empowerment first so Comet Storm consumes more stacks (talent-gated to builds that take it - some Spellslinger builds do not, so zero casts may be normal).

major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown for its damage and Fingers of Frost generation; in AoE position it to hit as many targets as possible and pair it with Blizzard during Freezing Rain.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use before Ray of Frost at the start of the burst window or when your group needs the haste, typically only once per boss fight; coordinate so it is not wasted on top of another Bloodlust effect.

major_cooldowns.name: Icy Veins
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Sync with Time Warp and on-use trinkets at the opener and on cooldown for maximum burst; the Midnight rework deemphasizes it for Frost, so it may not always be on your bars.

major_cooldowns.name: Shifting Power
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel to reduce your cooldowns when you have nothing higher-priority to cast or are otherwise targetless during an intermission; in AoE only channel it when 3 or more targets are present.

rules.description: Open by getting Ray of Frost rolling early
rules.action: Open with Blizzard for AoE or a Frostbolt/Frostfire Bolt for single target, then cast Ray of Frost as soon as possible so its cooldown starts cycling; the whole opener is built around getting Ray of Frost online early.

rules.description: Always be casting - never stand idle
rules.action: Never stop casting while waiting to decide; if no proc or cooldown is up, cast Frostbolt or Frostfire Bolt as filler, using Ice Lance only when moving, because a suboptimal cast always beats casting nothing.

rules.description: Spend Brain Freeze with the Flurry Shatter combo
rules.action: When Brain Freeze is active, cast Flurry so its Winter's Chill lands before your in-flight Frostbolt, then immediately follow with Ice Lance to Shatter; do not hold the proc unless Thermal Void uptime is at risk.

rules.description: Empty Fingers of Frost before Brain Freeze
rules.action: Spend your Fingers of Frost charges with Ice Lance before starting a Brain Freeze Flurry combo so a single Ice Lance does not waste both a Fingers of Frost charge and a Winter's Chill stack at once.

rules.description: Burst with Time Warp into Ray of Frost
rules.action: Pop Time Warp and on-use trinkets just before Ray of Frost so your highest-damage channel and Comet Storm conversion all land inside the haste window.

rules.description: Add Blizzard and spread Frozen Orb at 3+ targets
rules.action: At 3 or more targets, weave Blizzard into the rotation (especially during Freezing Rain) and position Frozen Orb to clip the whole pack; Comet Storm and Cone of Cold then Shatter multiple targets at once.

rules.description: Only channel Ray of Frost when safe to finish
rules.action: Plan ahead so you can complete the full Ray of Frost channel without moving; if a mechanic forces you out, Shimmer to safety mid-channel rather than canceling and losing the cast.

rules.description: Hold a Ray of Frost charge for priority windows
rules.action: With Hand of Frost granting a second Ray of Frost charge, keep it on cooldown but bank the extra charge for boss vulnerability phases or priority adds instead of dumping both charges back to back.
